actions.mechanism: Group matching file hashes only within identical license records; preserve every source asset as an expandable member.
actions.implementation: Add indexed group keys using hash and license identity. Keep unknown licenses separate. Show copy counts and member paths; retain original files.
actions.check: Identical files sharing a license condense; identical pixels with different license records remain separate selectable results.
actions.risk: Hash differences leave some visually identical files uncondensed.

actions.action: Record intentional variants as explicit relationships
actions.mechanism: Human-confirmed relationships connect crops, annotations, and originals without treating visual similarity as interchangeability.
actions.implementation: Provide relationship types such as cropped-from and annotated-from between asset IDs. Display linked variants without automatically collapsing them or inheriting licenses.
actions.check: Link two crops to one original; verify all remain independently searchable, selectable, and associated with their own licenses.
actions.risk: Incomplete or mistaken relationships require correction controls.

actions.action: Record the exact licensed file each project used
actions.mechanism: An append-only usage record binds project selections to specific assets, rather than changing group representatives.
actions.implementation: On project attachment or export, record project ID, asset ID, hash, path, license-record revision, and timestamp. Preserve replacements as new events.
actions.check: Change the displayed duplicate representative; project history must still identify the originally selected file and license revision.
actions.risk: Files used outside instrumented workflows need manual recording.

actions.action: Serve condensed results directly from the existing index
actions.mechanism: Precomputed grouping fields avoid request-time hashing, relationship traversal, and filesystem access on the critical search path.
actions.implementation: Index group keys, counts, and card metadata. Page over groups and independent variants; fetch member lists and relationship details only on expansion.
actions.check: Benchmark cold and warm first-page loads across representative queries and expected concurrency; require each measured load below one second.
actions.risk: Index updates may temporarily leave group counts stale.

actions.action: Offer task-specific filters without suppressing variants
actions.mechanism: Dimensions, creators, folders, and explicit version types narrow results through user intent instead of inferred similarity.
actions.implementation: Add combinable indexed filters with removable chips. Compute duplicate counts within the filtered result set; keep missing metadata in an explicit unknown category.
actions.check: Filter for a crop's dimensions and folder; verify the crop remains discoverable and clearing filters restores excluded assets.
actions.risk: Folder conventions and creator metadata may be inconsistent.

actions.mechanism: Persistent keep-separate exceptions protect intentional distinctions that matching hashes and license records cannot fully describe.
actions.implementation: Add a keep-separate control to expanded members, recording actor and reason. Exclude flagged assets from condensation and provide a reversible exception list.
actions.check: Separate two byte-identical assets intentionally maintained in different folders; verify both appear independently after reindexing, then test reversal.
actions.risk: Accumulated exceptions can reintroduce clutter and need review.
